name: Your Turn
source:
Have you ever been pursued by a series of failures? Could you imagine that all of them are connected to something mystical? The hero of this story was also convinced that it was all just coincidences until the events of one Halloween party forced him to doubt it. Will he manage to find support from those around him, or will it be too late, and what follows him will achieve its goal...

[From [url=https://liquidpixel-media.itch.io/your-turn]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是否曾被一连串的失败所困扰？你能想象所有这些都与神秘的事物有关吗？这个故事的主人公也坚信这一切只是巧合，直到一次万圣节派对上发生的事件迫使他对此产生了怀疑。他是否能找到周围人的支持，还是为时已晚，而跟随他的将会达到目的……

[来自[url=https://liquidpixel-media.itch.io/your-turn]itch.io[/url]]
